senses.gloss: m. h. a. ch. (b. h., v. לוּב) Libyan.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 8:3:4">Y. Kil. VIII, 31ᶜ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 5:1:4">Y. Sabb. V, beg. 7ᵇ</cite> an Egyptian bean when fresh <he>צווחין ליה ל׳ וכ׳</he> is named Libyan, when dried, they call it Egyptian bean; … <he>הדא אמרה הוא ל׳ הוא מצרי</he> this proves that Libyan and Egyptian means the same (v. <cite ref="L00176"><he>לוּב</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Yoma 2a:3">Ib.</cite> <he>גר מל׳</he> a proselyte descendant of a Libyan.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 2:5:9">Y. Shebi. II, 34ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>מיסרן דל׳</he> bunches of Libyan beans.—Pl. <cite ref="L00179"><he>לוּבִים</he></cite>. Y. Kil. l. c.; Y. Sabb. l. c., v. <cite ref="L00410"><he>לִיבְדְּקוֹס</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>גרים הבאים מל׳</he> proselytes, descendants of Libyans; v. <he>ליבוי</he>.
